heading: INT. GALLERIA MALL - SMALL CLAIMS COURT - DAY

units.text: INT. GALLERIA MALL - SMALL CLAIMS COURT - DAY
A converted shoe store.
Rows of benches.
A judge's bench where the cash register used to be.
The shoe-sizing stool is the witness stand.
JUDGE FELICITY ADEBAYO-STONE, 60s, robe over a cardigan, glasses on a beaded chain.
DOMINIC TREMBLAY, 40s, plaintiff, folder of receipts.
PETRA LINDGREN, 30s, defendant, flour on her jacket.
Order, order. For the record, this is case 41-C. Mr. Tremblay v. Ms. Lindgren. Mr. Tremblay.
units.name: JUDGE

units.text: Your Honor, Ms. Lindgren sold me a wedding cake. It collapsed in the middle of the reception.
units.name: DOMINIC

units.text: Ms. Lindgren?
units.name: JUDGE

units.text: Your Honor, the cake did not collapse. It was pushed.
units.name: PETRA

units.text: By whom?
units.name: DOMINIC

units.text: By your uncle.
units.name: PETRA

units.text: My uncle was nowhere near the cake.
units.name: DOMINIC

units.text: He was on top of the cake.
units.name: PETRA

units.text: Counsel, please.
units.name: JUDGE

units.text: I'm not counsel, Your Honor. I'm the groom.
units.name: DOMINIC

units.text: And I'm sorry for your loss, Mr. Tremblay.
units.name: JUDGE

units.text: Thank you, Your Honor.
units.name: DOMINIC

units.text: Ms. Lindgren, did the cake have internal supports?
units.name: JUDGE

units.text: Four dowels and a central column.
units.name: PETRA

units.text: And your professional opinion on the collapse?
units.name: JUDGE

units.text: Your Honor, nothing in the dowel schedule accounts for a man in a rented tuxedo using the top tier as a diving board.
units.name: PETRA

units.text: That is slander.
units.name: DOMINIC

units.text: It is video.
units.name: PETRA

units.text: There is video?
units.name: JUDGE

units.text: Eleven phones, Your Honor. I have a flash drive.
units.name: PETRA

units.text: Dear God, a flash drive.
units.name: JUDGE

units.text: Your Honor, my uncle has a bad knee.
units.name: DOMINIC

units.text: Then he should not have been diving.
units.name: JUDGE

units.text: I rest my case.
units.name: PETRA

units.text: Your Honor, I request a refund of four hundred dollars.
units.name: DOMINIC

units.text: Mr. Tremblay, I request that you never again describe your uncle as "nowhere near" anything.
units.name: JUDGE

units.text: Understood.
units.name: DOMINIC

units.text: Judgment for the defendant. Ms. Lindgren, you may keep the cake.
units.name: JUDGE

units.text: There is no cake, Your Honor.
units.name: PETRA

units.text: Then I recommend you keep the flash drive.
units.name: JUDGE

units.text: The gavel, a shoehorn, cracks on the register.
Dominic gathers his receipts.
Petra gathers her jacket.
The Judge rubs her temples.
